correctness.rationale: Exact 2+(M-2) invariant orthogonal decomposition of the symmetric next-generation matrix; peripheral eigenvalues at most r; Rayleigh quotient of the hub block exceeds r for zeta>1. Stated boundary cases are separately checked. The 575 numerical, 42 exact-polynomial, 9 exact-boundary and 1863 criticality tests are only supplementary.

value.rationale: Resolves four explicitly posed source conjectures in a natural epidemiological network model and replaces multiple graph-specific calculations by a complete invariance theorem. Provides an exact spectral reproduction number independent of arbitrary peripheral travel and sharp flux optimization/criticality boundaries. Structural robustness of invasion thresholds is useful precisely because graph-dependent transients remain different.
